# CVUnicorn

> CVUnicorn is an AI personal website builder. Users upload a resume/CV plus optional career materials — photos, projects, articles, press coverage, testimonials, talks, research, business results — and CVUnicorn's AI designs and publishes a polished personal website in minutes.

## Product

- What it does: turns career materials into a designed, hosted personal website. No design or coding skills required.
- Pricing: $0.99 Preview Pass (site live for 3 days) · $9.99 Unicorn Year (site live 12 months, custom domain included). One-time payments, no subscription.
- Generation time: typically under 5 minutes.
- Audience: founders, executives, designers, developers, academics, consultants, creators, marketers — the input flow adapts per profession.
- Key property: output scales with input. A CV alone yields a clean one-page site; rich uploads yield a multi-section, magazine-style site with galleries and dedicated pages.
